control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service

facts.title: hazard report - kinetic exposure at SC-8320

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on SC-8320 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. SC-8320 (reagent screw conveyor) is in service for dry reagent transfer. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 14 October 2014 a hazard report was recorded on SC-8320 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
